description: HP-88 is the registration code for the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) in Fatehpur, situated in the Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil) and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and other transport regulatory tasks for the Fatehpur sub-division.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Fatehpur, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
